# superset_dashboard (Data Source)

Looks up a dashboard by its slug or its title, for example to embed it with `superset_dashboard_embedding` or to send it with `superset_report`. Slugs are unique; titles are not, so a lookup by title fails when several dashboards share it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_dashboard" "sales" {
  slug = "sales"
}

resource "superset_dashboard_embedding" "sales" {
  dashboard_id    = data.superset_dashboard.sales.id
  allowed_domains = ["https://intranet.example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Slug of the dashboard, the last part of its URL. Set either `slug` or `title`.
- `title` (String) Title of the dashboard. The comparison is exact. Set either `slug` or `title`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the dashboard.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the dashboard is published.
- `status` (String) `published` or `draft`.
- `url` (String) Path of the dashboard in Superset.
